verdict: A near-identical rebuild of the Wikipedia main page whose only visible gaps are Arimo standing in for the page's Arial/Helvetica and a 1-3 px vertical drift in the column content; it is a well-named, component-based Figma tree but with absolute top-level placement, spacer frames and no shared styles.

top_defects.what: Arimo substituted for the reference's Arial/Helvetica sans-serif: the glyph shapes differ slightly, and the bold 19.2 px section headings ('From today's featured article', 'In the news') render a little wider and heavier than in the reference

top_defects.where: left and right columns, section headings and bodies
top_defects.what: the heading boxes start about 1 CSS px right of and below the reference (500 px wide inner boxes instead of 502/590 with their border), and the body text drifts down by 1-3 CSS px toward the bottom ('Did you know' bullet, 'In the news' items, Kimi Antonelli caption). These sub-pixel text offsets are what push the grid meanDiff to 20-40 in the lower cells
meanDiff 14.0 and pctDiff 9.7 % even though nothing looks misplaced at a glance: text anti-aliasing and the small vertical drift account for most of it
no text or color styles or variables (styled: 0): #3366cc, #202122 and the heading greens and blues are repeated as raw values, and footer link rows and figures are not components

top_defects.where: root frame, Header, Page toolbar, figures
top_defects.what: the root, Header and Page toolbar are not auto-layout (63 absolute layers): the header items, columns and Appearance menu sit at fixed coordinates, and the photo Figures are placed absolutely inside auto-layout bodies

top_defects.where: Welcome banner, Appearance menu, Tab instances
top_defects.what: 1 px wide 'Spacer' frames are used for spacing instead of gap or padding, and the unselected Tab instances (Talk, View source, View history) keep a 67x2 'Selected indicator' layer that a variant should handle

strengths: Every block (header, toolbar with the onboarding dot, welcome banner, both columns, Appearance panel) is present at its measured position and size, with exact surface colors (#f9f9f9, #f5fffa/#cef2e0, #f5faff/#cedff2)
All text is exact, line breaks included (Świeczkowski, 'Eunos / MRT station', 'Blueberry-flavored frozen / yogurt'), and the three photos are correctly cropped
Real vector logo and icons, and meaningful components (Tab, Section heading, List item, Radio option) with 20 instances and readable layer names
